notes.title: Version 1.2.4.5 is now live!

Greetings,

We have just put version 1.2.4.5 up and it has the active tooltip overlay, and updates to the Save/Load system.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Version 1.2.1.0 is now live!

This version has a new system in place to provide faster Save/Load times.

Unfortunately, this means that your older save files are no longer compatible. 

IMPORTANT
If any issues occur once the update is complete try to clear out the SaveData and ActiveData folders located in your Buildanauts/GameData directory.
